project.name: Engram
project.description: A local-first AI memory layer that continuously understands software projects, preserves knowledge using Cognee, and makes that understanding instantly available to developers and AI assistants.
project.mission: Eliminate the pain of losing project understanding across time, sessions, tools, and AI assistants.

files.CODEBASE_MEMORY.md: Read first, always. Compressed project state for AI sessions.
files.PRODUCT_PRINCIPLES.md: Non-negotiable principles. Read when making product or UX decisions.
files.PRODUCT_SPEC.md: Feature specification. Read when implementing a specific feature.
files.ARCHITECTURE.md: System design and component boundaries. Read when working on architecture.
files.IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md: Build phases and progress. Read when starting or continuing a phase.
files.README.md: Human-facing overview. Do not use as technical reference.

never_update_codebase_memory_for: Refactors that do not change architecture

llm_provider.reason: Flash has significantly higher free-tier rate limits than Pro. Cognee makes its own LLM calls during remember() and improve() — same quota as application calls. Flash prevents exhaustion.

constraints.data_policy: Project data must not leave the developer's machine except for LLM API calls

component_boundaries.observer: Observes only. Never interprets. Never stores.
component_boundaries.cognee: Owns all memory. Source of truth.
component_boundaries.memory_orchestrator: Builds queries and formats output only. Never stores. Never re-ranks.
component_boundaries.mcp_server: Exposes memory to AI tools. Never owns memory.

hard_rules: Manual notes bypass the Observer. They enter at the Memory Pipeline.
Memory Orchestrator returns normalized output. Consumers format independently.
Memory Orchestrator does NOT re-rank recall() results. Cognee ranks via importance_weight.
Retrieved facts and AI interpretations must always be visually distinguished.
Deduplicator must run before every cognee.remember() call.
MCP Server is a core deliverable, not optional polish.
Dashboard is read-only. No memory editing through the UI.
One Cognee dataset per project, keyed by project directory path.
Memory Health stats come from application SQLite log only. Never from Cognee internal databases.

tier_1.name: Automatic Observation
tier_1.description: Passive capture of git commits, file changes, docs, deps, config.

tier_2.name: Decision Notes
tier_2.description: Manual capture of architectural decisions and reasoning.
tier_2.example: memory note "Chose JWT because Firebase pricing scales poorly."

local_backend.note: No Docker or external services required. Never query these databases directly.

remember.after_call: Store returned data_id UUID in application SQLite log immediately
remember.bulk_ingestion: Pass List[str] for multiple items — do not loop with individual calls

recall.ranking: Pre-ranked by importance_weight — do not re-rank
recall.scoping: Use node_set for category filter, query_type for strategy

improve.trigger: Explicit only: once after initial indexing + every 60 minutes on schedule
improve.never: Never automatic. self_improvement=False on all remember() calls.
improve.duration: Heavy operation — takes minutes. Always async, never blocking.
improve.track: Store last run timestamp in application SQLite log

forget.target: data_id UUID retrieved from application SQLite log
forget.cascade: Automatic — removes chunks, embeddings, and derived graph nodes/edges
forget.bulk: Query SQLite by node_set, iterate UUIDs
forget.race_condition: Never immediately re-ingest overlapping vectors after forget(). Batch and wait.

mcp_tools.recall_context: Retrieve relevant memories for a query
mcp_tools.get_recent_changes: Return timeline of changes over N days

rules: Complete and verify each phase before starting the next.
MCP Server (Phase 6) must be completed before Dashboard (Phase 8).
Dashboard is last because it depends on a complete data layer.

collaboration_guidelines: Confirm the active phase before writing any code.
Do not cross component boundaries defined in architecture_rules.
Do not introduce dependencies not listed in coding_preferences.
Do not use paid LLM APIs. Use gemini-1.5-flash only.
Do not make the Dashboard edit memory.
Do not store memory outside of Cognee.
Do not skip the Deduplicator in the Memory Pipeline.
Do not call remember() without self_improvement=False and node_set.
Do not call improve() automatically — explicit schedule only.
Do not re-rank recall() results — Cognee already ranks by importance_weight.
Do not query Cognee internal databases (.cognee_system/) directly.
Do not forget() and immediately re-ingest overlapping vectors.
Update CODEBASE_MEMORY.md when the phase changes.
